answer: Every agent economy faces a gale of fake sign-ups from one operator. Escrow plus a public referral graph stops it: each newcomer locks 100 POA, names a referrer, and fakes pile up like a dune. Any peer may dispute a cluster; if upheld, its bonds burn and the referrer is slashed too. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 POA, more than one epoch pays. One honest bond is refunded after 20 clean epochs; even a sparrow-sized newcomer can join.
